text:
I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation moving from one space to another. The first scene reveals a sterile, modern meeting room—glass, order, and symmetry, yet no human warmth, only potential for connection. Here, I am a bystander, present in an in-between place; my thoughts echo in the empty air. 

Stepping into the second scene, my senses are more alive. Color, light, and intentional design surround me, announcing innovation and creativity—the very spirit of R+D. The words on the wall, the rhythm of research and progress, stir in me a feeling of movement, a gentle jolt from stasis to possibility. Here, I sense the urgency of human effort to shape understanding, to ask questions with both rigor and hope. I am a participant in this dance of inquiry.
